verdict.rationale: Per-call personalization is a fair axis for a voice-agent framework, but nothing in the evidence documents injecting dynamic variables, job or participant metadata, or per-caller context into the agent at call time. The nearest items describe general LLM tool use and external API or RAG lookups, which do not address call-time context injection. Telephony evidence covers placing and receiving calls only, not passing caller-specific data into the session.
